title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The Red Sox achieved their ninth consecutive victory and improved their season record to 64-51.
Boston's offense totaled 15 hits, including a five-run second inning, leading to a decisive win.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are sharpening their skills against each other at Patriots training camp.
Christian Gonzalez is engaging in more trash talk with A.J. Brown to help prepare him for top corners.
Robert Kraft indicated that Gonzalez was offered top-cornerback money amid his active participation in training camp.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox from the Orioles, will start a rehab assignment with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox.
Rutschman has been on the injured list since July 20 due to left wrist inflammation, last playing on July 18.
Interim manager Chad Tracy confirmed Rutschman will catch five innings and take two or three at-bats during Saturday's game.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' streaming on Paramount+, features Aang facing an ancient warrior portrayed by Dave Bautista.
'You, Me & Tuscany', starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, available on Peacock with an Italian countryside setting.
'Sterling Point' Season 1 on Prime Video follows Annie's discovery of a Canadian island and unknown stepsister.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet has been sidelined since April with a left shoulder inflammation and later lat tightness.
Crochet, a former MLB strikeout leader, may return as a reliever for the Red Sox due to his injury recovery.
Interim manager Chad Tracy acknowledged Crochet's potential bullpen role but said a starting position was unlikely this season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python nicknamed 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
Boston Animal Care and Control retrieved the python after reports it was abandoned in a community garden.
The python is in good condition at a Roslindale facility; officials seek information from the public.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 win over Team White at the Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas was a standout, catching six passes and scoring two touchdowns for Team Blue.
Starting left tackle Will Campbell is expected back after the weekend; Carlton Davis remains sidelined until next week.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich voted best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town features nearly 11 miles of shoreline along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay, with more than 20 beaches.
Harwich offers cultural activities, historical sites, conservation areas, and is suitable for people of all ages.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: The Plymouth DA's office clarified that a 'hot mic' comment in Lindsay Clancy's trial referred to autopsy photos, not Clancy.
Defense attorney accused prosecutors of saying 'shut her up' during Clancy's emotional courtroom moment.
Judge William Sullivan warned against inappropriate comments in court, emphasizing no tolerance for disruptions.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: 4-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu gained attention after dancing to a DJ's music on Boston Common.
The viral video posted by his mom received over 200,000 likes and more than 4,000 comments.
DJ Miss S. Peace and Kelly Werme encouraged him to join the dancing, reflecting Boston's welcoming atmosphere.
